newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR ENDS FIRMER, AROUND HIGHS.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR ENDS FIRMER, AROUND HIGHS.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures built on an earlier rally from downside support during Monday evening trading, and finished firmer around the highs.
Traders said the trend reflected a short-covering bounce in New York, where nearby October was filling a chart gap.
LIFFE October bounced off a low of $320 hit earlier in the session, re-bounding on mostly trade buying. The market closed at $322.80, up $2.70 from Friday. Total turnover was 1,999 lots.
However, technical analysts said the outlook for October was turning more bearish although there was still cause for optimism while support held at $315.
